reviews.text: I really like this lip liner! The color is beautiful and easy to match with different lip products. It glides on smoothly, is easy to apply, and helps define my lips without feeling dry. The formula lasts well throughout the day and makes my lipstick look even better. I’m very happy with this purchase and would definitely buy more shades.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢支唇線筆！顏色靚，而且容易配搭唔同嘅唇部產品。畫上去好順，唔難用，可以勾出唇形又唔會覺得乾。配方全日都keep到妝，而且令到我支唇膏睇起上嚟更加靚。我對今次嘅購物好滿意，一定會再買多啲其他色號。

reviews.text: This is one of my favorite lip pencils. The shade suits me perfectly, and the formula is smooth without feeling dry. It helps define and slightly overline my lips, making them appear fuller and more shaped. Very easy to use and blends beautifully with other lip products.
reviews.zh: 呢支係我至愛嘅唇筆之一。色號好啱我，配方順滑又唔覺乾。佢可以幫我勾出唇線同埋輕微畫出唇線外面，等個唇睇起上嚟更加豐滿同有形。好易用，同其他唇部產品融合得好好。

reviews.text: again, a super nice formula, and the brown shade was super good for not only lining, but also countouring around my lips, which gave the illusion of more volume. it is also really pigmented! in the photo, it’s the first/top swatch (shade oat beige btw)
reviews.zh: 又，配方超級好，啡色色號唔止畫唇線超好用，仲可以幫唇邊修容，營造出更加豐盈嘅錯覺。顯色度都好高！相入面係第一個／最上面嗰個試色（順帶一提，色號係 oat beige）。

reviews.text: Salmon beige is similar shade to the rose beige. But more of a burnt orange rather than taupe shade which I wanted for more pouty natural shadows around lip. Still goes with my 3ce lipstick in melting smore for a soft nude coral lippy. This is my current daily lip makeup for work
reviews.zh: Salmon beige 呢個色號同 rose beige 相似。但係比較似焦橙色，唔係我想要嘅灰褐色——我本來想用嚟幫唇邊整出自然豐厚嘅陰影。不過配搭我支 3ce melting smore 唇膏都可以做到柔和裸色珊瑚唇妝。呢個係我而家返工嘅日常唇妝。

reviews.text: I chose this shade because it’s similar to Roland’s Taupey shade. If you’re looking for something similar like me, it is comparable but a bit more brown and slightly darker. It’s still a good contouring shade. It’s a thicker tip, great for applying soft layers. However, the bottom turns like it’s a cap but nothing comes off so I’m not sure if this is a manufacturing error.
reviews.zh: 我揀呢個色號係因為佢好似 Roland 嘅 Taupey 色號。如果好似我咁想搵類似嘅，佢係可比嘅，但係偏啡少少，深少少。仍然係一個好嘅修容色號。筆頭粗少少，好啱輕輕一層一層咁畫。不過，底部好似有個蓋咁轉，但係咩都扭唔出嚟，唔知係咪有製造瑕疵。

reviews.text: Probably my favorite lipliner! The packaging itself is very nice, the cap is a light metal material. Great blendability, smooth, and stays on well. As I eat, drink, and talk throughout the day.. my liptint usually disappears but this lip liner seems to stay. Although it doesn’t look exactly like when initially applied, it still looks good. I bought this in three colors, and am happy about all three.
reviews.zh: 應該係我至愛嘅唇線筆！包裝本身好靚，個蓋係輕金屬材質。易推開，順滑，而且keep得耐。我成日食嘢、飲嘢、傾偈……我支唇釉通常都會甩色，但係呢支唇線筆好似keep得到。雖然睇起上嚟唔係同初初畫嗰陣一模一樣，但係仍然好睇。我買咗三個色，每個都好滿意。

reviews.text: The product goes on surprisingly smooth!! It has a very creamy and smooth texture and is easy to apply and blend while not disappearing quickly. I wouldn't recommend using the product for the corners of the lips or inside of the lips, but it works perfectly for overlining or coloring in the edges of the lips which is how I use it! Below are photos showing the shade comparison to other products <3
reviews.zh: 呢件產品畫上去出奇地順！！質地好creamy又滑，好易塗同推開，而且唔會好快甩色。唔建議用喺唇角或者唇內，但係用嚟畫出唇線外面或者填滿唇邊就好完美，呢個就係我嘅用法！下面有相顯示同其他產品嘅色號比較 <3

reviews.text:
Lip liner: Nice neutral-cool toned pink colour. Matches my lip colour quite well so can use for many lipsticks. Lasts a long time and is really smooth to use.
lip tint: formula feels like a thinner version of a rom&nd juicy lasting tint. Is a bright almost barbie pink colour. Doesn’t last very long sadly.
reviews.zh:
唇線筆：好靚嘅中性偏冷調粉紅色。同我本身唇色幾夾，所以可以配搭好多唇膏。持久度高，用起上嚟好滑。
唇釉：配方感覺好似 rom&nd juicy lasting tint 嘅薄身版。係好鮮明、幾乎似 barbie 粉紅嘅顏色。可惜唔算好持久。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
